messages:
maria: FYI we're getting tickets about surprising quota splits after the routing-policy rollout. Console shows separate lines for the same customer across routes.
kevin: Any evidence it's the SDKs?
maria: Traces show client headers differ: mobile (Go proxy) sends `rw-attrib`, web (TS) sends `X-Redwood-Context` JSON, server jobs (py) send `billing_tag=acct:org-z`.
olga: Yep, different header names+formats are creating distinct attribution keys, which the quota aggregation uses.
kevin: Short term: Console could offer a "unified view" toggle that merges buckets by acct id for visualization only. That would reduce noise while we fix SDKs.
maria: I like that, but label it clearly: "visual merge (not billing)". We should also surface adoption metrics per SDK so customers know who needs to upgrade.
olga: Agreed. SDK plan: TS middleware to emit a canonical textual header `X-Redwood-Attribution: acct=...;route=...` in addition to JSON. Py to add same header by default behind FEATURE_FLAG for 1 week. Go proxy to append lightweight canonical header (acct-only) to avoid parsing overhead.
kevin: Important: keep everything feature-flagged so we can toggle in flight if we see anomalies. Also add unit tests for mixed-case header handling and missing route values.
maria: Console changes: 1) add "canonical adoption" metric card showing % traffic with canonical header by sdk (TS/Py/Go). 2) add toggle above charts "Show unified attribution" with tooltip explaining merge logic. 3) make soft-merge non-destructive (billing pipeline continues to use raw buckets).
olga: Telemetry: emit `console.attribution.canonical_pct` with tags sdk_language and region. Also emit `sdk.emit_canonical` from client libs so ingestion can track.
kevin: For routing-policy interactions: if a fallback route is used we might get different route tags for same acct across retries. Console merge should avoid collapsing different routes if both present; only collapse when acct matches and one route is missing.
maria: Good point. Merge heuristic: if acct matches AND (routeA==routeB OR routeA missing OR routeB missing) then merge under acct with route="unknown" flag in viz. If both routes present and differ -> do not merge.
olga: SDK migration checklist: TS PR with middleware + tests, Py PR to add header behind env var, Go PR to add minimal header and perf bench. We'll coordinate a 48h migration window where both headers are emitted.
kevin: Also add a small support playbook for customers: curl examples to check headers and steps to opt-in SDKs. We'll include troubleshooting steps if quota moves unexpectedly.
infra-bot: scheduled: console-unified-view canary 2026-07-08T20:00Z -> 5%/25%/100% with synthetic mixed-header traffic.
maria: I'll draft the release note and add the support blurb. Olga, can you add the metric card wireframe?
olga: On it. I'll also add a drilldown that shows underlying raw buckets when you click the unified line.
kevin: I'll open the TS PR today and coordinate with Py/Go owners. Keep opt-in off by default.
maria: Action items: Kevin (TS PR + tests), Py owner (structured header behind flag), Go owner (header shim + bench), Olga (console metric + unified toggle UI + drilldown), Maria (release note + support doc). Recheck in 24h here.
kevin: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-ts/pull/560 (middleware + tests).
maria: Great, thanks. Follow-up tomorrow after canary scheduling.
